allowed_only_when: an authoritative DOC-B/DOC-C/DOC-D requirement affecting the system changes
fresh reproducible regression evidence proves the current implementation is defective
an unavoidable dependency or security fix requires a change and impact/regression verification is completed
prohibited: changing contracts to make other failing tests pass
using another subsystem failure as justification to alter a protected system
before_any_allowed_change: update this protection record with new proof

truth_boundary: Protection is tied to the audited subsystem/spec match at snapshot d677ba05e3a144950240805c25a393b572df8eb1. It is not proof that the whole repository is release-ready.
